description: UI layer: three new WhatsApp pages, sidebar nav update, OverviewPage WhatsApp section + KPI tiles, and App.tsx routes. Depends on FEAT-001 (types, hooks, API layer must exist). Does NOT touch any existing Sarvam pages, hooks, or API calls.
steps:
1. Create src/pages/WhatsAppAgentPage.tsx — WhatsApp Agent overview page. Structure:
   - Page wrapper: <div className='space-y-6'>
   - Header: h1 'WhatsApp Agent', p subtitle 'Manage your WhatsApp connection, AI assistant and conversations.'
   - Connection bar card (bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-card p-4): flex row with: green WhatsApp icon + 'WhatsApp Connected' green dot badge + 'Connected' chip; Phone Number '+91 98765 43210' (static); Business Name 'Carmel College' with checkmark; Quality 'High'; 'Manage Connection' button (border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm).
   - Three tab buttons (Overview active by default — manage with useState): 'Overview' | 'Conversations' | 'Leads & CRM'. Active tab: border-b-2 border-green-500 text-green-600. Use tab state to show/hide sections.
   - Overview tab content — 3-column grid (grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5):
     COL 1 'AI Assistant Status' card: green toggle (ON state, useState aiOn). When ON show green dot + 'Active — Automatically responds to incoming WhatsApp enquiries'. 'Pause AI' button (w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-lg py-2 text-sm flex items-center gap-2 justify-center). Info text below: 'Pause AI individually from any conversation without affecting other chats'. Below info show 'AI Off Count: X' pulling from useAiOff().data?.length ?? 0.
     COL 2 'Assistant Performance' card: 3×2 grid of stat mini-tiles. Data from useAgencyUsage().data (fallback to 0 for all). Tiles: Conversations this month (totalConversations icon MessageSquare), AI messages sent (aiMessages icon Zap), Human messages (humanMessages icon Users), Response rate (calculate as Math.round((aiMessages/totalConversations)*100)+'%' or '—' if 0), Qualified leads (qualifiedLeads icon UserCheck), Booked counselling (bookedSessions icon CalendarCheck2). Each tile: p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl, icon in green circle w-6 h-6, value text-lg font-bold, label text-xs text-gray-500.
     COL 3 'Conversation Activity' card: period selector (This Month / Last Month useState). Line chart using recharts LineChart + Line. X axis: dates of current month (1-30), Y axis: count. Approximate data: derive from useLeads().data by grouping lastActivity date field. If no date data, render a static example curve with 30 zero-points (show 'No activity data' label). Chart height 200.
   - Bottom row — 3-column grid (grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 mt-5):
     LEFT 'WhatsApp Business Profile' card: green circle w-16 h-16 with 'CC' initials centered. p font-bold 'Carmel College'. p text-sm text-gray-500 'Admissions, courses, eligibility, fees and counselling assistance for Carmel College.' Email row (Mail icon + 'admissions@carmelcollege.edu'). Website row (Globe icon + 'carmelcollege.edu'). 'Edit Profile' button (w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-lg py-2 text-sm mt-3).
     MIDDLE 'Recent Conversations' card: header with 'Recent Conversations' + 'View All →' link (NavLink to='/whatsapp/conversations' green). Table with columns Contact | Last Message | Last Activity | AI | Status. Data: useLeads().data?.slice(0,5) ?? []. Each row: green circle avatar with initials, name, lastMessage truncated 40 chars, lastActivity or '—', AI badge (green dot 'On' if aiEnabled else gray 'Off'), status badge (Qualified=green-100 text-green-700, Booked=blue-100 text-blue-700, Open=yellow-100 text-yellow-700, Not Interested=red-100 text-red-700, default=gray-100). Empty: 'No data yet' centered text.
     RIGHT 'AI Usage This Month' card: useAgencyUsage().data. Two progress sections: 1) 'WhatsApp AI Messages' — aiMessages / 3000, green progress bar (w-full bg-gray-100 rounded-full h-2; inner div bg-green-500 w-[X%]), show 'X / 3000' and percentage. 2) 'Human Handoff Messages' — humanMessages / 500, same style. Show percentages. Clamp bar width at 100%.

2. Create src/pages/WhatsAppConversationsPage.tsx — Conversations page matching the WEBKONIC WhatsApp Conversations Dashboard reference image. Structure:
   - Page wrapper: <div className='flex gap-4 h-full' style={{height:'calc(100vh - 120px)'}}>
   - LEFT COLUMN (w-80 flex-shrink-0 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-card flex flex-col):
     Header: 'Conversations' h2. Filter tabs row: All | Unread | AI | Human — each shows count badge from useLeads() data. Active filter: bg-green-100 text-green-700 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium. useState activeFilter.
     Search box: input placeholder 'Search contacts...' with Search icon, rounded-lg border border-gray-200.
     Conversation list (overflow-y-auto flex-1): useLeads().data?.filter(by activeFilter). Each item: flex items-center gap-3 p-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-xl border-b border-gray-50. Left: green circle w-10 h-10 with initials (first letter of name). Middle: div flex-1 min-w-0 — p-1 font-medium text-sm name, p-2 text-xs text-gray-500 lastMessage truncated. Right side: time (lastActivity), AI/Human badge pill, status badge pill, unreadCount bubble (if >0: green circle w-5 h-5 text-white text-xs). Selected state: bg-green-50 rounded-xl. Click sets selectedLead state. Empty state: 'No conversations yet' centered.
   - MIDDLE COLUMN (flex-1 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-card flex flex-col):
     If no selectedLead: centered empty state with MessageCircle icon and 'Select a conversation to view messages'.
     If selectedLead selected: Header (flex items-center gap-3 p-4 border-b border-gray-100): green circle avatar with initials, name + phone text-sm text-gray-500, status dropdown (select element, border border-gray-200 rounded-lg text-xs px-2 py-1), icons row (Phone, Tag, MoreVertical from lucide-react).
     Chat area (flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 bg-gray-50 space-y-3): Show placeholder messages based on selectedLead data. First: user message bubble (bg-white rounded-2xl rounded-tl-none shadow-sm p-3 max-w-xs self-start) with lead name and a sample enquiry text derived from lastMessage. Then: AI Agent response (bg-green-50 rounded-2xl rounded-tr-none p-3 max-w-xs self-end) with green bot icon + 'AI Agent' label + response text. Show 'No messages yet' if no lastMessage.
     Message input (flex items-center gap-2 p-3 border-t border-gray-100): '+' button (circle), input placeholder 'Type a message...', emoji/attach icons, green send button.
   - RIGHT COLUMN (w-72 flex-shrink-0 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-card flex flex-col overflow-y-auto):
     Three tabs: Contact | Lead | Activity (useState activeDetailTab). Tab bar: flex border-b border-gray-100. Active: border-b-2 border-green-500 text-green-600 font-medium.
     Contact tab content: green avatar circle (w-16 h-16 mx-auto mt-4 mb-2 text-2xl). Name h3. Phone row (Phone icon). WhatsApp row (MessageCircle icon + 'WhatsApp'). Email row if available.
     Lead Status: label 'Lead Status' text-xs text-gray-500 mt-4 mb-1. Dropdown select: Qualified / Booked / Open / Not Interested / New. Styled border border-gray-200 rounded-lg w-full text-sm px-3 py-2.
     Tags section (mt-4): label 'Tags'. Tag pills: flex flex-wrap gap-1. Show selectedLead.tags ?? ['BSc Nursing','2026 Intake']. Each tag: bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full. '+ Add Tag' button.
     Actions section (mt-4): label 'Actions'. Buttons list (space-y-2): 'Pause AI for this Conversation' (Pause icon), 'Assign to Human' (UserCheck icon), 'Mark as Booked' (Calendar icon), 'Mark as Sold' (Check icon), 'Add Note' (FileText icon). Each button: w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50.
     Notes section (mt-4): 'Notes' label + '+ Add Note' green button text-xs. Show selectedLead.notes ?? 'No notes yet' in text-sm text-gray-500 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3.

3. Create src/pages/WhatsAppLeadsPage.tsx — Leads & CRM page. Structure:
   - <div className='space-y-6'>
   - Header: h1 'Leads & CRM', p 'All your WhatsApp leads and contacts in one place.'
   - Stats row (grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4): 4 StatCards using StatCard component from src/components/StatCard.tsx:
     'Total Leads' = useLeads().data?.length ?? 0
     'Qualified' = useLeads().data?.filter(l => l.status==='Qualified').length ?? 0
     'Booked' = (useOkCalls().data?.length ?? 0)
     'AI Active' = useLeads().data?.filter(l => l.aiEnabled).length ?? 0
   - Filter bar (flex gap-2 flex-wrap): buttons for All | Qualified | Booked | Not Interested | New | Open. Active: bg-green-500 text-white rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-sm. Inactive: bg-white border border-gray-200 text-gray-600 rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-sm hover:bg-gray-50. useState activeFilter.
   - Search input (relative max-w-xs): Search icon + input placeholder 'Search leads...' rounded-full border border-gray-200 bg-white pl-8 pr-4 py-2 text-sm.
   - Table card (bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-card overflow-hidden): table w-full text-sm. Header row: bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-100, columns: Contact | Last Message | Last Activity | AI Status | Lead Status | Actions. Each data row from filtered+searched useLeads().data: Contact cell (green avatar circle w-8 h-8 initials inline mr-2 + name font-medium + phone text-xs text-gray-500 below), Last Message (text-gray-600 max-w-xs truncate), Last Activity (text-gray-500 text-xs), AI Status (green dot 'On' if aiEnabled else gray dot 'Off'), Lead Status badge (same color scheme as WhatsAppAgentPage), Actions cell (flex gap-1 — View button icon Eye text-gray-400 hover:text-green-600; AI toggle icon BotOff if aiEnabled; Pencil icon for Add Note; CalendarCheck2 icon for Set Booked). Loading state: 'Loading leads...' text. Empty state: 'No leads yet' centered.
   - Merge data: combine useLeads().data, useAnsweredLeads().data, useOkCalls().data into a deduplicated list by id (use useMemo). Show merged list, filter and search client-side.

4. Update src/components/Layout.tsx — add new nav items to the navItems array and add WhatsApp section header. Changes: - Add these lucide-react imports to the existing import list: MessageCircle, MessagesSquare, Users (check if already imported; if not add them) - Replace the existing navItems array definition with a sectioned structure. Keep existing behavior — the rendering loop already maps navItems. New navItems array: { to: '/', label: 'Dashboard', icon: }, { to: '/live-calls', label: 'Live Calls', icon: }, { to: '/calls', label: 'Voice Agent', icon: }, { to: '/whatsapp', label: 'WhatsApp Agent', icon: }, { to: '/whatsapp/conversations', label: 'Conversations', icon: }, { to: '/whatsapp/leads', label: 'Leads & CRM', icon: }, { to: '/attempts', label: 'Attempts', icon: }, { to: '/campaigns', label: 'Campaigns', icon: }, { to: '/analytics', label: 'Analytics', icon: }, { to: '/boards', label: 'Boards', icon: }, - Keep otherItems unchanged (Settings). - Add a visual separator/label between voice and WhatsApp items inside the SidebarContent render: after the '/calls' item and before '/whatsapp', insert a small section label

WhatsApp

. Implement this by rendering navItems in two sub-groups OR by adding a divider NavItem type with a `divider` flag. Simplest approach: split navItems into voiceItems (/, /live-calls, /calls, /attempts, /campaigns, /group-by, /analytics, /boards) and whatsappItems (/whatsapp, /whatsapp/conversations, /whatsapp/leads), render them separately with a 'WhatsApp' section label between 'MAIN MENU' items and 'Other'. - Keep all existing layout JSX, header, user profile, mobile toggle — ONLY the nav item list changes.

5. Update src/pages/OverviewPage.tsx — add WhatsApp section at the bottom and two KPI tiles in the KPI row. Changes (add ONLY, remove nothing): - Add imports: useAgencyUsage and useLeads from '../hooks/useSetSmart'; NavLink from 'react-router-dom' - At the top of the OverviewPage function body, add: const { data: waUsage } = useAgencyUsage() and const { data: waLeads } = useLeads() - In 'KPI row 2' (the grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4), expand to grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 and append two new StatCard entries after the existing 4: - At the very BOTTOM of the JSX (after the heatmap div, before the closing ), add a new section:

Recent WhatsApp Conversations

View All →
table with columns Contact | Last Message | AI | Status; data from waLeads?.slice(0,3) ?? []; same badge styles as WhatsAppAgentPage; empty: 'No WhatsApp data yet'
- Add MessageCircle to lucide-react imports (check existing imports first)

6. Update src/App.tsx — add three new routes inside the existing <Route path='/' element={<Layout />}> element (do NOT change any existing routes):
   - Import WhatsAppAgentPage, WhatsAppConversationsPage, WhatsAppLeadsPage from their new src/pages/ files
   - Add: <Route path='whatsapp' element={<WhatsAppAgentPage />} />
   - Add: <Route path='whatsapp/conversations' element={<WhatsAppConversationsPage />} />
   - Add: <Route path='whatsapp/leads' element={<WhatsAppLeadsPage />} />
acceptance_criteria: src/pages/WhatsAppAgentPage.tsx renders with connection bar, 3 tabs, AI Status card with toggle, Assistant Performance 6-stat grid, Conversation Activity line chart, Business Profile card, Recent Conversations table, AI Usage progress bars
src/pages/WhatsAppConversationsPage.tsx renders 3-column layout: conversation list with filter tabs, chat view, contact detail panel with Contact/Lead/Activity tabs and Actions
src/pages/WhatsAppLeadsPage.tsx renders 4 KPI StatCards, filter bar, search, and a full table with AI Status and Lead Status badges and action icons
src/components/Layout.tsx shows new nav items: WhatsApp Agent, Conversations, Leads & CRM with correct icons, with a 'WhatsApp' section label. Existing nav items unchanged.
src/pages/OverviewPage.tsx has two new KPI tiles (WhatsApp Convos, Qualified Leads) and a Recent WhatsApp Conversations table at the bottom. Existing content untouched.
npm run build exits 0 — zero TypeScript errors across all new and existing files
